label: step3-b
tail:
Step-3 review complete for group **b** (batches 4, 5, 6). Both outputs written; `scaffold-verdicts` reports 8/8 A pages reviewed, 0 unreviewed.

## Verdicts — all three `insufficient`

**Batch 4 · `sigma-algebras-and-borel-sets`** (42 + 16 items)

The design's every DEF and THM is present and all five traps hold (π–λ in three lemmas, monotone class decomposed the same way with the *first* good-sets pass its own item, seven generators as one item, ω₁ **stages**, no countable additivity). The route that does not close:

- **B4-1/B4-2 (high)** — `λ(E)` and `M(E)` are defined as intersections but nothing proves the intersection *is* a λ-system / monotone class. Five items consume that fact: contract derivation `second-good-set-pass` applies `lem-lambda-good-sets` with `D = λ(P)`, whose hypothesis is exactly it. σ-algebras got this as a landmark; these two got nothing. Trap (iii) — "the definite article is earned" — in the two places the design didn't name.
- **B4-3/B4-4 (low–med)** — the `proved_here: false` strictness remark rests only on a Berkeley course note that supplies no proof; needs a Kechris/Srivastava locator. Two unused dependency edges on the cardinality theorem.

**Adjudicated against the dispatch:** the run-specific check says AC_ω must appear in the Statement of |B(Rⁿ)| = 𝔠. I approved Beta's full-AC correction instead. ZF gives a definable injection ω₁ → B(ℝ) (α ↦ the Borel set of reals coding well-orders of type α), so AC_ω proving the equality would prove ω₁ ≤ 𝔠, which ZF+DC does not (Solovay). The design's trap 3 is the error. Verified from disk that `thm-regularity-of-the-alephs` (b) carries full AC while `thm-countable-subsets-of-omega-one-are-bounded` gives exactly the AC_ω boundedness — Beta's dependency swap is right too.

**Batch 5 · `the-fundamental-group-of-the-circle`** (21 + 4)

A page is sound; the B page is where it's thin.

- **B5-1 — repaired by me.** `kind: "false_statement"` is not a legal kind; `validate-plan.mjs:146` raises a hard `prefix` error, so the step-4 splice would have failed. Fixed in place.
- **B5-2/B5-3/B5-4** — no witness that the "length < 1" hypothesis the covering proof consumes is sharp (p|[0,1) is a continuous bijection that isn't a homeomorphism); the design's third B item ("what became available") is absent; nothing separates degree zero from constancy.
- **B5-5** — the Hatcher locator stops at Theorem 1.7, so FTA-via-π₁, Brouwer dim 2 and Borsuk–Ulam get no disposition row. Content decision is right (design assigns them to HT-7); the record should say so.

F5-1 through F5-5 approved (re-pin already on disk and verified: `thm-sine-and-cosine-parametrize-the-unit-circle` is on `fundamental-trigonometric-identities`, 185 → 179). **F5-6 and F5-7 declined — owner decisions.** The alias transfer needs the deferred record deleted first, and the two stale scope-denial prose items are not dependencies of this level, so the repair delegation doesn't reach them. Declining F5-7 leaves a real cost I've flagged for step 10: once HT-4 publishes, `ex-circle-as-r-mod-z` asserts the library does *not* identify R/Z with the unit circle while another published page proves it does.

**Batch 6 · `goursat-and-cauchys-theorem-in-a-convex-domain`** (16 + 8)

Strongest scaffold of the three; all thirteen designed items plus three load-bearing additions, all five traps honoured. Findings:

- **B6-1 (med)** — Ahlfors §1.4 Thm 2 and Stein–Shakarchi Cor 1.2 (the rectangle theorem) are dispositioned `inline` to `thm-goursat-triangle-theorem`, whose proof absorbs neither. A false harvest row; mint `cor-goursat-rectangle-theorem` (split on a diagonal) or decline it honestly.
- **B6-2 (med)** — both B counterexamples list `fs-every-continuous-complex-function-on-a-domain-has-a-primitive` in `deps` while the notes admit it isn't load-bearing. It *is* citable (A page, order 307) and the design says cite don't rebuild — so use its [L2]/[L3] or drop the edge.
- B6-3/B6-4/B6-5 low.

F1–F6 all approved, each verified from disk: `thm-cantor-intersection-metric`'s four chain conditions match; `thm-well-ordering-principle` is the ZF least-element principle, not the AC-equivalent, so the deterministic selection is honest; the off-centre kernel genuinely is not `thm-circle-integrals-of-integer-monomials`' centred clause. One obligation created: `cor-closed-contour-integral-of-a-derivative-is-zero` requires **F′ continuous** — satisfied in all three uses, but step 5 must discharge it, not elide it.

## Cross-checks

All 102 distinct external dependency ids across the three batches exist on disk; none has an `ai-generated` statement; none is legacy-unclassified; no internal forward references; no pair near the 60-item ceiling, so no split adjudication was owed. Files changed: `research/frontier-15-batch-5.pages.json` (the kind fix) plus the two group-`b` outputs. Everything else is routed to the owning Betas via the verdicts file, since each finding adds or retitles a proof-bearing item and needs a matching contract and coverage row.
